defaultValue: The layout settings on this page are read once, when a new game is created; changing them later does not touch an existing save. The meteor shower toggle works at any time.

fieldDescription: Adds the Sol system to a new sector.
Where Sol sits on the sector map. If the spot is taken, Sol is nudged to the nearest free space. Default -54000.
Adds the Centaurus constellation about 4 light-years from Sol: Alpha Centauri (three stars, Proxima b) and Beta Centauri (a lonely blue giant).

fieldName: How many Remnants live in Sol
fieldDescription: None: no Remnants at all. Light: a couple of nests in the outer system, the inner planets are free to colonize. Heavy: nests at Jupiter, Saturn and Mercury plus a patrol, the inner system is contested. Overrun: nests around the Sun and at most planets with big patrol fleets, Sol is a Remnant fortress.
Adds a Domain-era coronal hypershunt orbiting Sol, with its usual guardians.
Needs Ashes of the Domain: Vaults of Knowledge. Mars becomes the shipyard world. AOTD still places its own Nidavellir somewhere else too.
Needs Ashes of the Domain: Vaults of Knowledge. Adds the Pluto Mining Station. AOTD still places its own somewhere else too.
A Domain-era prison station in the outer system. Break in and wake one of eight prisoner officers.
Needs Industrial Evolution. Meteor showers hit Sol on a seasonal schedule while you are in or near the system.
